en: A colorized vintage postcard view of a harbor scene. In the foreground is a white steamship full of passengers, with a tall smokestack emitting smoke. The ship bears the name "NORRTELJE / NORRTELJE" on its bow and upper deck. Behind it are quays, moored sailing ships and large, classical stone buildings along the waterfront. In the upper left corner the caption reads "Stockholm." The style suggests an early 20th-century printed postcard.
